# docs/ — operator notes

## Purpose

Human-facing evidence for `wtf-live`: what the page looks like, how a run was
verified, and the exact commands used. The root `llms.txt` is the contract;
this folder is the proof.

## Ownership

- `wtf-live.png` — captured page (1400×920, headless Chrome) used as the visual
  reference in reviews.
- `llms.txt` — this file.

Old fleet/operations/roadmap notes described the retired `wtf` hub (MCP bridge,
federation, encrypted session channels) and were removed with that code. Git
history keeps them if they are ever needed.

## Verification recipe

```bash
cargo build --release
./target/release/wtf-live serve --no-open &
curl -s localhost:7800/healthz
curl -s localhost:7800/api/snapshot | jq '.counts, [.sources[] | {name, ok, detail}]'
printf 'deploy plan\nstep 1' | ./target/release/wtf-live bin put --title demo
curl -s localhost:7800/api/bins | jq '.bins[0]'
```

Capture the page without touching a user browser profile:

```bash
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
  --headless=new --disable-gpu --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-wtf \
  --window-size=1400,920 --virtual-time-budget=5000 \
  --screenshot=docs/wtf-live.png http://127.0.0.1:7800/
```

## Work Guidance

- Keep captures current with the shipped UI; delete stale images instead of
  keeping multiple versions.
- Never put tokens, absolute home paths, or machine credentials in this folder.
